meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude在成功执行编辑操作后，如果注释检查器报告警告，会先修复或解释被标记的注释，然后才继续。
howto.when: 当Claude成功执行apply_patch、write、edit等编辑工具后，且注释检查器检测到问题并发出警告时触发。

say.text: 修复被注释检查器标记的问题注释。
say.note: Claude会尝试修改注释以消除警告。

say.text: 解释为什么这条注释会被标记。

howto.what_en: After successful edit actions, if comment-checker reports a warning, Claude must first fix or explain the flagged comment before moving on.
howto.when_en: Triggered after successful edits (apply_patch, write, edit, etc.) when comment-checker detects an issue and emits a warning.

say_en.text: Fix the comment flagged by the checker.
say_en.note: Claude will modify the comment to resolve the warning.

say_en.text: Explain why this comment is flagged.
say_en.note: Claude will provide the reason for the flag.
